findings.description: The windshield wiper on the right side of the car spontaneously relocates its base and flips its direction. Initially, the base is near the center of the windshield cowl and the blade points to the right, towards the woman. As the camera zooms in, the base appears on the flat hood surface near her elbow, and the blade points to the left, in the opposite direction.
